name: Node Classification and Regression
problem_statement: Train or apply a graph model to predict categorical labels or numerical targets for specified vertices.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

problem_inputs.name: training_labels
problem_inputs.description: Labels restricted to the declared training split.

problem_inputs.name: split
problem_inputs.description: Disjoint train/validation/test vertices and transductive or inductive policy.

problem_inputs.name: model_definition
problem_inputs.description: Architecture, loss, optimizer and training/inference budget.

required_outputs.name: predictions
required_outputs.description: Per-vertex predictions for the requested evaluation split.

required_outputs.name: model_state
required_outputs.description: Serializable learned parameters or a local artifact reference.

solution_semantics.objective: Minimize the declared supervised or semi-supervised loss on training labels.
solution_semantics.exactness: Learned estimates; no globally optimal model is required.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Disjoint label splits prevent training on evaluation labels.
Prediction shapes match the declared task.
Recompute metrics from predictions and held-out targets.
edge_cases: Isolated vertices require a declared aggregation convention.
Missing features or labels are handled explicitly.

correctness: Disjoint label splits prevent training on evaluation labels.
Prediction shapes match the declared task.
Recompute metrics from predictions and held-out targets.
